title: Add deterministic report fanout synthesis status evidence
instructions:
Implement only S3 for references/initiatives/structured-agent-fanout-autopilot.md. Add deterministic synthesis/status evidence for report fanout outputs without adding reportFanoutExecution, dispatching workers, creating worktrees, writing run logs from continuation, mutating lifecycle outside existing status-update behavior, merging, cleanup, committing, pushing, batch planning, batch execution, or worker-owned orchestration.

Keep the implementation in src/core/sequential-ceo-autopilot.ts and focused tests in tests/sequential-ceo-autopilot.test.ts plus CLI coverage in tests/cli.test.ts. Do not change src/cli.ts unless existing CLI behavior cannot expose the new core validation through continuation:update-status; prefer no CLI source change. Do not touch policy, contracts, hooks, task templates, agent profiles, batch artifacts, operation artifacts, package metadata, lockfiles, or doctrine files.

Required behavior: introduce a closed optional `reportFanoutSynthesis` object on SequentialContinuationStatusEvidenceDocument. This object is status evidence only, not an execution trigger. Use deterministic fields such as `candidateArtifactPath`, `synthesisReportPath`, `inputReportPaths`, `rolesReviewed`, `status`, `conflicts`, and `expectedSideEffects`. Validate it as closed schema: repo-relative local paths only; no command strings, URLs, absolute paths, traversal, environment expansion, globs, missing required arrays, unknown roles outside report/spec/reviewer/evaluator, unknown status outside accepted/blocked, unknown fields, or non-false side effects. Reuse the report fanout false side-effect vocabulary where practical.

Trusted transition rule: when the current continuation artifact has a present reportFanoutCandidate and currentSlice.actionType is report_only, a completed status update must include accepted reportFanoutSynthesis evidence, cite the synthesisReportPath in evidenceReferences as continuation_report or report_review with result passed/clear/completed, have no conflicts, and preserve false side effects. Recommendation-only report evidence, missing synthesis evidence, uncited synthesis output, or conflicted synthesis must not complete the slice. Conflicting advice must block or reject deterministically instead of averaging: a blocked status update with reportFanoutSynthesis.status blocked and non-empty conflicts may update the current slice to blocked with a blocked_report nextStep; a completed update with any conflicts must be rejected.

Do not require reportFanoutSynthesis for ordinary report_only artifacts that do not carry reportFanoutCandidate; preserve existing status update behavior for run_task, readiness_check, manual_decision, run accept, run task, next-artifact linkage, and reportFanoutCandidate preflight. Add tests proving: accepted synthesis completes a report fanout report_only slice; missing synthesis cannot complete a report fanout slice; recommendation-only advice cannot complete it; synthesis output must be cited; conflicts block or reject instead of being averaged; side-effect requests are rejected; CLI continuation:update-status exposes the accepted and rejected paths without creating runs, worktrees, batch artifacts, commits, pushes, or lifecycle side effects beyond the artifact file update already owned by that command.

Update references/initiatives/structured-agent-fanout-autopilot.md only to mark S3 completed with focused verification and set exactly one next ready slice: S4 batchPlanCandidate validation/report-only visibility. Do not implement S4 or S5. Run all verify commands after implementation. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
